name: generated-and-graph-transitions

files.main.c:
int value(void);
int main(void) { return value(); }

build_ninja:
rule cc
  command = cc -O2 -g0 -frandom-seed=0 -fdiagnostics-color=never -DVALUE_BIAS=0 -I. -MD -MF $out.d -o $out -c $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule link
  command = cc -frandom-seed=0 $in -o $out
rule generate
  command = cat $in > $out
rule marker
  command = cp $in $out
build generated.h: generate ../source/generated.in
build main.o: cc ../source/main.c
build stable.o: cc ../source/stable.c
build lib.o: cc ../source/lib.c || generated.h
build app: link main.o lib.o stable.o
